description: Действие происходит за несколько лет до событий основного сериала. В центре внимания беременность матери Май и рождение Мисаки.

en: Mahou no Star Magical Emi: Kumo Hikaru

In this 15-minute short story, released more than 15 years after the finale of the popular Mahou no Star Magical Emi franchise, a new life was born into the Kazuki family. How did her baby brother change the family's life and what are Mai's feelings about him. At the end of an eventful day for the siblings and Shou, another concert is waiting for Emi.
